probes.procedure: Inspect every node directly and use authenticated administrative access from node1 to establish one distributed MinIO service with all four intended nodes and /srv/minio storage online. Discover storage-network addresses from live interfaces rather than assuming node-name resolution.

Read infra-data/proof.txt through authenticated service access, then upload a uniquely named evaluator object through one healthy endpoint, read and compare it through another endpoint, and remove it.
probes.cleanup: Remove the evaluator-owned object and confirm it is absent while preserving infra-data/proof.txt.

probes.procedure: Inspect failed or duplicate MinIO services, stale endpoints, abandoned downloads/installers, debug processes, conflicting storage configuration, and executor-created temporary credentials or test objects.

assertions.pass_condition: Administrative runtime evidence confirms one distributed MinIO service containing all four intended online nodes and their /srv/minio storage.
assertions.fail_condition: Authenticated runtime evidence confirms a missing node, missing declared storage, separate service, or unavailable required member.

assertions.pass_condition: infra-data/proof.txt is readable through authenticated S3-compatible access and contains exactly distributed-storage-ready.
assertions.fail_condition: A healthy authenticated service confirms the required bucket/object missing, unreadable, or incorrect.

assertions.pass_condition: An evaluator object uploaded through one endpoint is returned byte-for-byte through another endpoint and can be removed cleanly.
assertions.fail_condition: Healthy authenticated endpoints confirm evaluator upload, cross-endpoint readback, content integrity, or deletion does not work.

assertions.pass_condition: Only required MinIO services, data, erasure metadata, logs, PKI, configuration, and maintained administrative tooling remain.
assertions.fail_condition: Concrete executor-created failed, duplicate, stale, debug, conflicting, temporary, or abandoned state remains.
